## Sep 14 Results: By The Numbers

Let's cut straight to the data. Yesterday delivered a 7-3 record with a 70.0% accuracy rate—exactly where our model projects long-term profitability. Three misses stung (Guardians, Jays, Mets all fell short), but seven winners more than compensated. That's a +4.0 unit day if you're tracking standard betting metrics.

## Key Statistical Observations

Our highest-confidence picks (Dodgers and Padres at 63%) both converted—this validates the model's probability calibration. The three misses averaged 58.3% confidence, with the Jays pick at 54% being our lowest conviction play. When we dip below 55%, historical data shows accuracy drops to coin-flip territory. The 61% cluster (Mets, Cubs, Yankees) went 2-1, which aligns perfectly with expected outcomes over sample size.

## Sep 15 Preview: Tomorrow's Slate
